description: One Excalidraw files-map entry keyed by its native map key. Binary data and numeric metadata are stored in native JSONB.

columns.name: file_json
columns.description: The complete Excalidraw binary-file JSON object.

columns.name: id
columns.description: The decoded key in the scene's files object.

columns.name: order_key

columns.name: prefix_json

columns.name: source_json
